# Master Services Agreement

This Master Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of January 1, 2026 between Cloudforge Inc., a Massachusetts corporation ("Vendor"), and Beacon Financial Services, a Massachusetts corporation ("Client").

## 1. Scope of Services
Vendor will provide cloud hosting, managed services, and support for the platforms identified in mutually-executed Statements of Work.

## 2. Term and Renewal
The initial term is thirty-six (36) months. The Agreement renews automatically for successive twelve-month terms unless either party provides ninety (90) days' written notice of non-renewal.

## 3. Confidentiality
Each party will protect the other party's Confidential Information, including customer data, service architecture, and pricing terms. Publicly available information is excluded. The obligation has no fixed expiration.

## 4. Indemnification
Vendor will indemnify Client against third-party intellectual-property infringement claims and claims arising from Vendor's gross negligence. Vendor's aggregate liability under this clause is capped at two times (2x) the fees paid by Client during the twelve months preceding the claim.

## 5. Termination
Either party may terminate this Agreement for material breach upon sixty (60) days' written notice and a thirty (30) day cure period, for insolvency, or for convenience with sixty (60) days' notice.

## 6. Governing Law and Disputes
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. Disputes will first be submitted to non-binding mediation and, if unresolved, to binding arbitration under the AAA Commercial Arbitration Rules in Boston, Massachusetts.
